datasets.name: 39ab1cde
queryLines:
-- 4. Top 10 Users by Tweet Count
-- Replace `user` with your actual username column if different
SELECT
    user,
    COUNT(*) AS tweet_count
FROM tweets_bronze
GROUP BY user
ORDER BY tweet_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

datasets.name: c6ef5f4b
datasets.displayName: Top Mentions by Net Positive Sentiment Score
queryLines:
SELECT
    mention,
    SUM(CASE WHEN predicted_sentiment = 'positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN predicted_sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS net_positive_score
FROM tweets_gold
WHERE mention IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY mention
HAVING net_positive_score > 0
ORDER BY net_positive_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
